item.title: GET READY FOR ANOTHER FREEZE
item.description: Cold weather returns this weekend with lows dipping into the upper teens to mid-20s inland, and the low 30s along the coast. A Cold Weather Advisory is in effect for all of Southeast Texas early Saturday morning. Be sure to bundle up and take precautions before the freeze!
